command: isolated employee: call system_time once with {} and repeat its UTC timestamp
claim: A dedicated unbound employee executes system_time once and answers from its correlated result; other tools remain available.

scope.statement: One employee-mediated system_time call under a runtime one-call cap, verified by a complete correlated trace, independent clock window, matching answer and confirmed shutdown. Other tools remain available; this is not a tool-isolation test.
scope.entry: agent cloud run start/get; no approval resume, database or Discord
out_of_scope: Tool isolation or proof that other tools cannot execute

employee_tool.message: Call system_time exactly once with empty arguments {}. Use no other tool. After the result, reply with exactly the UTC timestamp returned by that tool, without commentary. Do not guess the time or answer without executing the tool.

criteria.claim: Completed run belongs to the requested employee and invocation
criteria.evidence: Deployment, returned run ID, execution ID and invocation payload match the captured request.

criteria.claim: Exactly one system_time call returns UTC time within the bounded clock window
criteria.evidence: Empty arguments, matching call/result IDs, successful terminal event; RFC3339 UTC result within harness start/end plus or minus 5 seconds. Missing/unsupported clock evidence stays unverified.

criteria.claim: Employee answer follows and agrees with tool result
criteria.evidence: Employee text after the result exactly repeats its timestamp; a guessed timestamp without the tool trace cannot pass.

criteria.claim: Target is confirmed stopped after completion
criteria.evidence: Authoritative target status and desired state stopped; supplied observation timestamp after completion.

employee_tool_result.title: Employee clock-tool workflow lacks the required execution evidence
employee_tool_result.expected: One system_time call, plausible UTC result, exact corresponding answer and confirmed shutdown.
employee_tool_result.impact: A correct-looking answer cannot be trusted as evidence of actual tool execution.
unknowns: Other result encodings or deployment environments are not established by this one observed run.
employee_tool_result.retest: Only after fresh authorization acknowledging the other available tools: use the dedicated unbound fixture with verified one-call limit and reviewed catalog. Require the complete correlated trace, exact clock answer and confirmed shutdown. No retry, approval or database fallback.

unverified_always.claim: Other tools unavailable or impossible to execute
unverified_always.follow_up: Not established and not claimed: the default built-in and live_data tools remain available. The cap limits calls; trace verification detects an unexpected call after execution. A successful clock trace does not prove access isolation.
Use provider version evidence if available; never infer it.
